goal: Improve progressive-result, loading, stale-state and recovery behavior while preserving already useful results and existing Tourvisor/search contracts.
never_touch: Tourvisor request/identifier contracts outside the owned recovery runtime
unrelated DS2 components or site sections
invariants: valid already-rendered results remain visible whenever recovery can continue safely
stale responses cannot overwrite a newer search state
simple recovery does not introduce unnecessary search_start or search_continue restarts
valid user input is not reset merely because a transient refresh fails
verification remains targeted to the changed recovery/performance surface

checks: one affected browser/user-flow scenario; add breakpoint-specific visual evidence only if layout changes

done_when: progressive or recovery changes do not discard valid rendered results unnecessarily
stale responses cannot overwrite a newer search state
no unnecessary search_start/search_continue restart is introduced
only the targeted search/recovery evidence required by the actual change is run
